visualCharacteristics.purpose: static list of authored routes with live lowest fares
traits: three-column grid of compact route teasers at desktop
small square destination image with a plane badge
origin over destination, price label and bold price right-aligned

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value. Rows: Origin | FRA or Frankfurt (FRA) (omitted: locale home airport); Destinations | CHI, WAS, IST or Chicago (CHI), ... (names authored in brackets are shown as is; otherwise names come from the fare service; omitted: the service recommends destinations); Trip duration | 7; Cabin | E; Price label | Round trip from; Link | optional URL pattern with {origin}, {destination}, {duration}, {cabin} (default: the locale's /book-and-manage/destination page); Conditions | text or link. The section heading stays default content above the block. UI strings have built-in English and German defaults chosen by the page language; any can be overridden with a row of the same name

usage: Seasonal deals sections on homepage and offers pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any curated route list with prices. Request and response mapping sit at the top of fare-teaser.js (fareTeaserRequest, mapFareOffers, buildDestinationLink).
